Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Dharm Trivedi, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Abhishek Kumar Singh, learned
counsel for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
205 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from
Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Nighashan, District Kheri.

sentences.text:
3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 27.03.2022 stating that the informant's daughter aged about 16 years had gone missing from home on 26.03.2022.
4.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she stated that she is aged about 18 years, she had gone with the applicant out of her own freewill and started living with him as his wife.
She wants to live with her husband-applicant.

sentences.text: In the medico legal examination report of the victim no mark of injury or sign of use of force has been reported.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she stated that she knows the applicant for the past one year, she had gone with him and stayed with him for 4-5 months.

7. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8. The State has filed a counter affidavit annexing therewith copies of relevant material collected during investigation and a copy of charge sheet dated 12.11.2022.
The learned counsel for the State has also submitted that the information of the application has been delivered to the informant through police.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the statements of the victim wherein she has not levelled any allegation against the applicant; that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 20.10.2022 and the investigation already stands concluded and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
10.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
